Development

This package uses Task to manage development tasks. Task is a modern alternative to Make that’s easier to use and more powerful.

Installing Task

First, install Task following the instructions at taskfile.dev.

Available Tasks

Once Task is installed, you can run the following commands from the root of the package:

# Display all available tasks
task

# Install R package dependencies
task install-deps

# Install Python dependencies
task install-py-deps

# Generate documentation
task document

# Build the package
task build

# Install the package
task install

# Check the package
task check

# Run tests
task test

# Build vignettes
task vignettes

# Clean build artifacts
task clean

# Run all main tasks (document, build, check, test)
task all

# Run CI tasks (install-deps, install-py-deps, document, check, test)
task ci
